bundle.shortDescription: Dual-suite Gaussian splatting and geospatial flood analysis
bundle.longDescription: InstaSplatter turns ordinary captures into photorealistic 3D Gaussian splats, then into metrically georeferenced maps with scientific and preview flood runs. Zero-config by default. All processing runs locally.
